ov: The heaviest member of the weasel family, and one of the few mammals that use tools: it cracks shellfish open with rocks. Unlike most marine mammals it stays warm with fur, the densest in the animal kingdom, not blubber.
rg: Coasts of the northern and eastern North Pacific.
df: Mostly sea urchins, molluscs, crustaceans and some fish. By eating urchins, it protects kelp forests.

cf.tip: A sea otter lives entirely at sea and has a short tail. All other otters have long, muscular tails.

fx: A loose pouch of skin under each foreleg holds the food it has collected.
